// Rooms: the registry. A room has a kind and a nightly rate, both changeable only here.
signal add_room(room: String, kind: String, rate: Int) -> Map   // Rooms
    // Register `room`. Error kind `Taken` if it exists. Returns map("room", room, "kind", kind, "rate", rate).
    requires rate >= 1
writes     kinds: Map<String, String> [persistent]   // room -> kind ("single", "double", …)
           order: List<String> [persistent]   // the rooms, in the order they were added
           rates: Map<String, Int> [persistent]   // room -> nightly rate in cents, >= 1
               invariant rates >= 1
